content.text: {"problem": {"theorem": "证明若实数 a<b，则 a^3<b^3。", "assumptions": ["a,b 为实数，且 a<b。"], "domain": "elementary_algebra", "explicit_subgoals": []}, "target": {"node_id": "n1", "version": 1}, "target_node": {"text": "由 a<b 可知 a^2<b^2。", "claim": "声称由 a<b 推出 a^2<b^2；此推断不成立，例如 -2<-1，但 (-2)^2>(-1)^2。", "scope": [], "depends_on": []}, "closed_predecessors": [], "patch": {"base_state_digest": "18f49a5487466e0d216739e041781844af280200dbe7b228b9c7d07546c0701f", "certificate_id": "e5975d46f8699948ec24a07d24301050d9228bc84a6068723f0768b18579fa97", "target": {"node_id": "n1", "version": 1}, "operation": "replace", "nodes": [{"node_id": "n1", "text": "由 a<b，得 b-a>0。又 a^2+ab+b^2=(a+b/2)^2+3b^2/4≥0；若其等于 0，则 a=b=0，与 a<b 矛盾，故 a^2+ab+b^2>0。因此 b^3-a^3=(b-a)(a^2+ab+b^2)>0，即 a^3<b^3。", "claim": "若实数 a<b，则 a^3<b^3。", "depends_on": [], "scope": [], "goal_refs": []}], "target_dependencies_after": [], "counterexample": null, "reason": "以立方差分解和正性论证替换无效的平方保序推断；该证明对任意实数 a<b 均成立。"}, "patch_digest": "53d66e444f87cf49d3faeef2929beedc89fd3fe21ee5b80f4773a698207081d4", "certificate": {"certificate_id": "e5975d46f8699948ec24a07d24301050d9228bc84a6068723f0768b18579fa97", "problem_digest": "2399eaff069d3e5e16d7131419ca75dfaab9c0a599af4b3def286425b0ed8c3e", "target": {"node_id": "n1", "version": 1}, "graph_digest": "9bcdf4c65b6b8869ed4234b05e055e27819b78fe5940f8f5ddf7bd03f1e3d817", "confirmation": "confirmed", "kind": "invalid", "failed_edge": "a<b ⇒ a^2<b^2", "quote": "由 a<b 可知 a^2<b^2。", "reason": "平方函数在整个实数域上不严格递增。反例：取 a=-2，b=-1，则 a<b，但 a^2=4>1=b^2，因此该推断无效。"}, "proposed_proof": "由 a<b，得 b-a>0。又 a^2+ab+b^2=(a+b/2)^2+3b^2/4≥0；若其等于 0，则 a=b=0，与 a<b 矛盾，故 a^2+ab+b^2>0。因此 b^3-a^3=(b-a)(a^2+ab+b^2)>0，即 a^3<b^3。\n再分别乘以 a 和 b，得到 a^3<b^3。\n因此立方函数严格递增。"}
